description:
AquaHunter is a source-transparent seafood market intelligence workspace for seafood professionals.

OFFICIAL MARKET BENCHMARKS
View the latest published weekly export unit value and export weight for fresh or chilled farmed salmon from Statistics Norway Statbank table 03024. AquaHunter preserves the official NOK/kg unit, weekly period code, national export-benchmark meaning, attribution, license and data cadence.

HISTORICAL CONTEXT
Explore published weekly observations across 6-week, 30-week and 1-year views. Values are presented in their source unit and are not converted into fictional city spot prices or executable offers.

OFFLINE WORLD MAPS
Pulse, Radar and Network include a world reference map built from bundled Natural Earth public-domain data. The map works without device location or paid map requests. It is not a nautical chart and must not be used for navigation, legal-boundary decisions, fishing-zone determinations or safety decisions.

CLEAR DATA LIMITS
AquaHunter does not manufacture missing observations. Radar and Network clearly state when fish-probability, buyer, trade, port or vessel data is unavailable because no approved commercial-use source is connected.

SAFETY AND CONTROL
A maritime operations and legal risk notice must be reviewed and accepted before first use. Settings provide appearance controls, language selection, repeat access to the notice and a direct support-email option.

The market value shown is a national weekly export unit value. It is not a city spot price, auction quote, investment recommendation or executable offer. Always follow official navigation information, maritime warnings, permits, closures, protected-area rules and competent authorities.

Data attribution: Source: Statistics Norway, table 03024. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
promotionalText: Track an official weekly salmon export benchmark with transparent source units, history, offline world maps and clear data limits.
